answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. What survives to the knoll is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The inlet holds work receipts rather than names, so the haven of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
